newsitem.title: USA: Paxson to says to sell WPBF to Hearst Corp.
newsitem.headline: Paxson to says to sell WPBF to Hearst Corp.

text.p: Paxson Communications Corp said on Wednesday it agreed to sell television station WPBF, an ABC affiliate in West Palm Beach, to Hearst Corp for $85 million in cash.

Paxson said the sale is another step in the company's redeploying resources to its core business segments, a Florida radio group and its inTV Television Network. The company recently sold its other West Palm Beach station, a UPN Network affiliate, as part of this strategy.
Paxson's television network is a group of 47 stations that specialize in long-form programming such as infomercials, 30-minute programs paid for by advertisers.
Paxson is based in West Palm Beach. Its shares were trading down 1/16 at 8-7/8 on Wednesday morning. Their 52-week high was 18-7/8.
